plugin.name: ADB
plugin.description: An Android shell over ADB in your browser. Termix speaks the ADB protocol itself, so the server needs no adb binary.

sessions.title: Open ADB sessions
sessions.description: Open an ADB shell to hosts the user can connect to.

privateKey.label: ADB key
privateKey.description: The RSA key this server proves itself to devices with. Made on first use.

allowPrivateNetworks.label: Allow devices on private networks
allowPrivateNetworks.description: ADB devices usually sit on your LAN. Turn this off to refuse hosts that resolve to private, loopback or link-local addresses.

enableAdb.label: ADB
enableAdb.description: Open an Android shell over ADB (TCP) on this host.

adbPort.label: ADB port
adbPort.description: The port adbd listens on: 5555 after "adb tcpip 5555", or the connect port shown on the Wireless debugging screen (Android 11+).

adb.authorizing: Allow USB debugging on the device screen (tick Always allow from this computer)...
adb.pasteRefused: Paste blocked by the browser. Use Ctrl+V
adb.refused: This address is not allowed (private network access is off)
adb.pairHelp: This phone uses Wireless debugging and does not know this server yet. On the phone open Wireless debugging → Pair device with pairing code, then enter the pairing port and the 6-digit code shown there (not the connect port).
adb.notPaired: This phone is not paired with this server yet.
adb.portChanged: The Wireless debugging port changes each time the feature is switched on. Enter the new port shown on the phone; pairing is not required again.

files.title: ADB Files
files.name: Name
files.confirmDelete: Delete {{count}} selected item(s) from the device? This cannot be undone.
files.pairFirst: Open the ADB tab of this host and pair the phone first.

power.title: Power
power.confirm: The phone will go offline and the open sessions will end.
